summary: Create an OAuth application in AAP (Access Management > OAuth Applications) with grant type Authorization code, client type Confidential and a placeholder redirect URI such as https://example.com; save the clientId and clientSecret for the OpenShift secret and replace the redirect URI after deployment.
questions: How do I create an OAuth application for self-service automation portal?
Which grant type does the portal OAuth app use?
What redirect URI do I use before the portal is deployed?
Where do I get clientId and clientSecret for the portal?

answer_card.title: Create the portal's OAuth application
answer_card.answer_md:
AAP > **Access Management > OAuth Applications > Create OAuth Application**:

- *Name*: any
- *Organization*: your portal org
- *Authorization grant type*: `Authorization code`
- *Client type*: `Confidential`
- *Redirect URIs*: a placeholder such as `https://example.com`

Copy the `clientId` and `clientSecret` for the OpenShift secret. After deploying, replace the placeholder with the URL derived from your deployment URL.
